products.title: [LR08] 13.5oz Double-Knee Distressed Mended Jeans
products.body_html:
Product information

Engineered for durability and character, these 13.5oz double-knee jeans combine raw cotton construction with intentional distressing and visible mending details. The reinforced knee panels extend wear life in high-stress areas, while the mended aesthetic adds narrative depth to each pair. Pure 100% cotton fabric develops a natural patina over time, rewarding regular wear with authentic fading and texture. A statement piece for those who value craftsmanship over perfection.
